_comments: API SCOPES FOR THE ACCOUNTING REMOTE OPERATIONS (#310). Every Accounting operation declares RequiredScope
accounting:read or accounting:write (metadata/remote-operations for the generated ones, the class itself for the
code-only ones). Without these rows MJAPI refuses every API-key call to them on a host that installs Accounting.
A parent `accounting` with read and write children, matching how MJ lays out its own scopes. The application
ceiling that allows them on MJAPI is in metadata/api-application-scopes. A host then only issues API keys.

fields.Name: accounting
fields.Description: Parent scope for Accounting remote operations

fields.Name: read
fields.Description: Read-only Accounting operations: batch previews, journal entry states, stranded entries, approval state and finance exception types

fields.Name: write
fields.Description: Accounting operations that change data: journal entries and reversals, batch build, dispatch, decisions and cancellation, ERP sync and finance exceptions
